LanguageData.Joy_Arcade.description: A bulky, coin-operated arcade cabinet with an aging CRT screen and colorful buttons. Though outdated, it still provides hours of digital entertainment. Classic games never truly die.
LanguageData.Joy_Arcade.label: arcade machine
LanguageData.Joy_DartsBoard.description: A simple dartboard mounted on a stand. A fun way to practice accuracy and hand-eye coordination. It trains shooting ability.
LanguageData.Joy_DartsBoard.label: darts board
LanguageData.Joy_InudstrialComputer.description: A bulky, outdated computer standing on a small desk. The screen flickers, the keys stick, and it hums with age, but it still runs simple programs. There's always some archaic software waiting to be used.
LanguageData.Joy_InudstrialComputer.label: old computer
LanguageData.Joy_ModernComputer.description: A sleek, high-performance computing station housed on a sturdy desk. Equipped with a fast processor, an ergonomic keyboard, and a crisp, flat-panel display, it offers a vast range of software: whether for research, entertainment, or light interstellar networking.
LanguageData.Joy_ModernComputer.label: modern computer
LanguageData.Joy_Piano.description: A compact upright piano designed for musical recreation. A great way to develop artistic skills and entertain others.
LanguageData.Joy_Piano.label: upright piano
LanguageData.Joy_PunchingBag.description: A sturdy, stand-mounted punching bag for combat training and stress relief. It trains melee combat ability.
LanguageData.Joy_PunchingBag.label: punching bag
LanguageData.Joy_RouletteTable.description: A sophisticated gambling table designed for playing roulette. A thrilling mix of chance and strategy, making it a centerpiece of any high-end casino or social space.
LanguageData.Joy_RouletteTable.label: roulette table
LanguageData.Radio_Industrial.description: An industrial-era radio for playing music and spoken broadcasts. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting. Provides passive music recreation to those that can hear it.
LanguageData.Radio_Industrial.label: industrial radio
LanguageData.Radio_Spacer.description: A state-of-the-art, high-fidelity radio that uses advanced longwave transmission to deliver crystal-clear music, broadcasts, and interstellar transmissions. Even on the rimworlds, someone out there is always transmitting something - whether it’s news, music, or distant voices from the void..
LanguageData.Radio_Spacer.label: longwave radio
LanguageData.VFE_Lounger.description: A reclining cushioned lounger designed for relaxation. Offers superior comfort but is not ideal for deep, restful sleep. Allows for sunbathing recreation.
LanguageData.VFE_Lounger.label: lounger
